provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: عدد الخانات العشرية من بيانات العملة
title.en: Fraction digits come from the currency's data

statement.ar: لا تفترض خانتين عشريتين. خذ عدد خانات الوحدة الصغرى من بيانات العملة (صفر، اثنتان، ثلاث) واستخدمه في التحليل والعرض والتخزين.
statement.en: Do not assume two decimals. Take the number of minor-unit digits from the currency's data (zero, two, three) and use it in parsing, display and storage.

rationale.ar: الدينار الكويتي والبحريني والأردني والريال العُماني والدينار التونسي بثلاث خانات. افتراض خانتين يرفض مبالغ صحيحة أو يخزّن عُشر القيمة.
rationale.en: The Kuwaiti, Bahraini and Jordanian dinars, the Omani rial and the Tunisian dinar have three decimals. Assuming two rejects valid amounts or stores a tenth of the value.

checks: "12.345" parses in KWD (12345 minor units) and is rejected in EGP and SAR.
amounts AM-014: "0.001" in KWD is 1 minor unit.
Formatting 1 minor unit shows as many fraction digits as the currency defines.
No source file contains a literal 100 used to convert between major and minor units.
